title: Warehouse & logistics
_note: English for work (english-for-work run, 2026-11-02): written by hand in British English, not yet checked by a second reader. translations.en = short definition in simple English; deHint = German translation (the 'German' tab). Words that already exist in the English lexicon are refs with a job-specific example.
intro: The words for work in a warehouse or distribution centre: equipment, picking and packing, goods in and dispatch, safety and talking to your team. Every word has an example sentence from a real working day in the UK.
introEasy: Do you work in a warehouse? Learn the words for boxes, pallets, orders and safety here.
tipps: Warehouse calls are short and loud: “Mind your backs!”, “Forklift coming through!”, “Heads up!” Learn them first, because they keep people safe.
If you do not understand an instruction, say “Sorry, can you say that again?” or “Can you show me?” Nobody minds, and it is better than a mistake.
Read the label or the pick list twice and say the numbers clearly. Many mistakes come from numbers, so repeat them: “Bay fourteen, one-four?”
